mentions.name: React in Godot
mentions.description: A complete implementation of React for the Godot game engine, enabling UIs to be built with React. The author plans to migrate breaka.club's HUDs and editor UI to it because Godot control nodes are somewhat cumbersome, and will open source the library soon.
mentions.problem: Godot control nodes are not impossible to work with, but somewhat cumbersome for building UIs.
